beats.vo: Groundtruth is a Chrome extension for a City of Sydney buyer. On Belvoir Street it shows a likely sale about eight hundred thirty-two thousand against a Microburbs value seven hundred eighty-five, and the six percent gap.
beats.caption: Likely sale vs Microburbs value
beats.action: REA 313/6 Belvoir St, Surry Hills: panel top shows "What it should sell for: about $832k" vs "Microburbs value $785k" and the gap line (+$46k, 6%).

beats.vo: Tap Verified home. The address match receipt expands with the G‑NAF id and four of four checks, so we know it’s the exact home.
beats.caption: [[Verified]] address match receipt, G-NAF id
beats.action: Same listing: clicking "Verified home" expands the address match receipt (address read, normalised, G-NAF id, 4/4 checks).

beats.vo: Type a guide as a buyer. Nine hundred thousand against the eight hundred thousand on record, flagged fifteen percent above Microburbs’ estimate.
beats.caption: Typed guide, checked in place
beats.action: Same listing: buyer types a $900k guide; panel says it differs from the $800k guide on record and sits 15% above Microburbs' $785k estimate.

beats.vo: See the agency’s guide‑versus‑sold record: seven of ten sold above their guide, median plus three point nine percent.
beats.caption: Agency guide-vs-sold record
beats.action: Same listing: agency card "7 of 10 of this agency's recent sales sold above their guide", McGrath Surry Hills, median +3.9%.

beats.vo: Realestate dot com dot au switches listings in place. We jump from Goulburn Street, about one point three million, back to Bourke Street, and the receipt updates to the new home.
beats.caption: Works when REA switches listings
beats.action: REA in-page navigation: search results -> 18/251-263 Goulburn St (about $1.3m) -> back -> 902/417-419 Bourke St; the receipt updates to the new home.

beats.vo: On Domain, Groundtruth reads the address and shows an exact address match.
beats.caption: Tested on 30 listings, 0 wrong homes
beats.action: domain.com.au 405/82-92 Cooper St, Surry Hills: panel shows an exact address match.

beats.caption: 30-second briefing
beats.action: Same Domain listing: the 30-second spoken briefing plays (real recorded audio, captions in the panel). No narration over it: vo must be "".

beats.vo: Here’s what can legally rise next door: two lots within one hundred metres could add four to five storeys.
beats.caption: 3D what can rise next door
beats.action: REA 902/417-419 Bourke St: verdict "2 lots within 100 m could rise 4-5 more storeys", 3D map of the home tower with glass headroom volumes.

beats.vo: Risk overlays: heritage on the property; flood not on it, nearest four hundred forty‑three metres; and a high‑voltage line about thirty‑five metres away.
beats.caption: Risks: heritage, flood, HV line
beats.action: Same listing: Risk overlays card: bushfire clear; flood not on property (nearest 443 m); heritage ON property ("Heritage controls may limit renovations"); HV power line nearest 35 m.

beats.vo: Street versus suburb: growth forecast three point four versus three point six a year, past two point four versus two point six, renters forty‑one versus fifty‑eight. Mid‑pack.
beats.caption: Street vs suburb growth
beats.action: REA 902/417-419 Bourke St: Street vs suburb card: growth forecast 3.4% vs 3.6%/yr (street vs suburb), past growth 2.4% vs 2.6%, renters 41% vs 58%, "Mid-pack".

beats.vo: Strata levy shown: five thousand three hundred twenty a year, one thousand three hundred thirty a quarter, the Surry Hills median across ninety‑seven buildings.
beats.caption: Strata levy, suburb median
beats.action: Same listing: Strata levy card: $5,320 a year, $1,330 a quarter, Surry Hills median across 97 buildings.

beats.vo: Price and value stay side by side, powered by the Microburbs API. Groundtruth.
beats.caption: Powered by Microburbs API
beats.action: REA 313/6 Belvoir St, Surry Hills: panel top shows "What it should sell for: about $832k" vs "Microburbs value $785k" and the gap line (+$46k, 6%).
